question: Find all posts created in 2014 that have at least one comment, identify the post with the highest favorite count among them, return the display name of its owner, and calculate the percentage of all posts by this owner that have a score greater than 5.

arguments.sql:
WITH posts_2014_with_comments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_026 AS post_id,
        p.XCL_033 AS owner_id,
        p.XCL_039 AS favorite_count
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM comments c 
          WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
      )
),
top_post AS (
    SELECT 
        owner_id
    FROM posts_2014_with_comments
    ORDER BY favorite_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM top_post tp
JOIN users u ON tp.owner_id = u.XCL_052
JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_033 = tp.owner_id

WITH posts_2014_with_comments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_026 AS post_id,
        p.XCL_033 AS owner_id,
        p.XCL_039 AS favorite_count
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2014'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM comments c 
          WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
      )
),
top_post AS (
    SELECT 
        owner_id
    FROM posts_2014_with_comments
    ORDER BY favorite_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM top_post tp
JOIN users u ON tp.owner_id = u.XCL_052
JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_033 = tp.owner_id
